name: Qwen Image Edit 2509 (Comfy Cloud)
description: Qwen Image Edit 2509 with its 4-step Lightning LoRA: the crop and a second picture (the Original or your first reference layer). Runs on your Comfy Cloud key; Scumble crops and stitches. Comfy's template as Comfy Cloud has it; not run on Comfy Cloud from Scumble yet.
